description: Agent Evaluation: submit one evaluation result report: each claim with its text, metric and claimed figure, the subset it comes from and whether the claim names it, the baseline it compares with and whether it says higher, lower or meets a threshold; each measured result with its metric, value, subset, sample size, spread (a standard deviation, a standard error or a 95 percent interval) and run conditions (model, dataset and date); each baseline result; and the subsets the evaluation ran beside the subsets the report shows. The signed report matches every claim to its measured figure and says whether the figure matches, whether each comparison runs the claimed way and clears the noise in both figures, whether a subset figure says so and whether every subset that ran is reported, and names every claim with no result, every figure the results do not show, every comparison with no baseline result, the wrong way round or inside the noise, every threshold claimed and missed, every undisclosed subset and every dropped subset, then every figure behind a claim with no sample size, fewer than 30 tasks, no spread or no run conditions, with the fix for each. This reads one result report’s claims against its own numbers: whether a benchmark claim’s figures appear in the source it cites is wever_benchmark-evidence-check, whether a claim is supported by offered evidence is wever_claim-evidence-check and one paid call’s result against its order is wever_result-validation-check. Verdict claims_unsupported, result_gaps, result_unverified or claims_supported. POST /api/evaluation-result-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-evaluation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-evaluation/.

kind.description: A standard deviation, a standard error, or a 95 percent interval half-width.

value.description: In the metric’s units, such as 2.1.

direction.description: Higher or lower than the baseline, or meets a threshold.

subset.description: The subset the figure comes from, if not the full set.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.
